section: 3.20 Botes, botes progresivos, y premios adicionales

participantDisclosure: Platform must clearly inform the participant when funds are being contributed to jackpots.
Platform must communicate how a participant can qualify for the jackpot.
All participants who contribute to a jackpot must be able to qualify to win it during play.
Jackpot conditions and requirements to win must be communicated to the participant.
accountingLedgerMinimum: periods during which each jackpot is active
configurable jackpot characteristics active at each moment
games/machines participating in or contributing to the jackpot at each moment
contribution to the jackpot differentiated by each game/machine type
jackpot awards with winner, amount and time
transfers or redirections to another jackpot
controlChecksAtLeastMonthly: once constituted and opened, conditions do not change until won and paid
winner-determination procedure awards only eligible winners and does not omit eligible winners
prizes are paid to listed winners
redirection mechanisms cannot postpone award indefinitely

2024MonitoringModel.fact: Casino game records for machines of chance are generated in the operator system in real time and reported by session in the DGOJ monitoring model.
2024MonitoringModel.researchImplication: Spain's regulated architecture is inherently event/accounting driven; EDGE should mirror that structure with timestamped immutable observations rather than relying on screenshots or current-value-only polling.

importantResearchConsequence: The operator's internal regulated records contain exactly the dimensions needed to solve many EDGE identity and history problems. Public research should reconstruct only what is legally/publicly observable and must never claim access to non-public DGOJ/operator records.
